subject: NimbusPay DPA route, SCCs & SOC2 evidence — signature cadence
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbuspay.eu>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbuspay.eu
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:14:00 +02:00
Subject: DPA redline + SOC2 and SCCs questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo earlier this week — NimbusPay is excited about the integration. Our legal and security teams sent a handful of items they need before we can move to contract signature: 

- Attached: our proposed DPA redline (NimbusPay_DPA_Redline_20270422.docx). Please confirm which redlines you can accept.
- We need confirmation Redwood will sign the EU SCCs (v2) or provide equivalent safeguards for EEA data.
- Please provide the latest SOC 2 Type II attestation summary / scope and any SIG or CAIQ evidence you can share; procurement expects a short summary PDF.
- DPIA note: because some flows will include payment metadata, our privacy team asks if Redwood will allow a 30-day window for our DPIA review once we receive the final DPA.
- Signature cadence: preference is customer legal -> vendor legal -> exec sign. We use DocuSign; can you confirm you’ll accept e-signature and provide a routing window (~3 business days)?

Can you loop in your legal contact and let us know a target date to finish signatures? We are targeting contract close by next Tuesday (2027-04-27).

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Senior Counsel, NimbusPay
[Attachment: NimbusPay_DPA_Redline_20270422.docx]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbuspay.eu>
Cc: procurement@nimbuspay.eu, irene.choi@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline + SOC2 and SCCs questions

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and for sending the redline. Looping in Irene from Legal and Markus (Privacy) to handle the DPA and SCCs questions.

High-level next steps from our side:
1) Legal will review your redline and push back only on a small set of clauses (subprocessor notice cadence, a limited retention cap, and the exec-signature threshold).
2) We will provide the SOC2 summary (PDF) and SIG/CAIQ highlights by end of day tomorrow.
3) For signatures: DocuSign is fine. Our proposed routing: Redwood Legal -> NimbusPay Legal -> Redwood Exec (if required). We can commit to a 72-hour signing window once the DocuSign envelope is sent.

Irene — can you pick up the redline and return a consolidated comment set? Markus — any immediate concerns re: DPIA / retention?

Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cell: +1 415-555-0198

> 
> Thanks for the demo earlier this week — NimbusPay is excited about the integration. Our legal and security teams sent a handful of items they need before we can move to contract signature: ...

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbuspay.eu>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -04:00
Subject: NimbusPay DPA redline — Redwood comment set and evidence

Hi all,

Thanks for the redline. I reviewed NimbusPay_DPA_Redline_20270422.docx and created a concise comments document (attached). High-level notes:

- Acceptable: the majority of the redlines are operational/clarity edits which we can accept.
- Exceptions: we cannot accept an unconditional 30-day notice on subprocessor changes; propose 10 business days for notice and an express carveout for emergency security patches.
- Retention: we can agree to a 5-year retention maximum for aggregate customer records; for payment metadata we propose 7 years where required by law.
- SCCs: Redwood will execute the EU SCCs (v2) via DPA addendum. We will append the SCC Annex and provide a signed copy in the final package.
- DPIA: Markus will coordinate a short statement and confirm whether any additional measures are required for NimbusPay-specific processing.

Attached evidence: SOC2_Type2_Cover_Summary.pdf (redacted control list) and our proposed consolidated redline: NimbusPay_DPA_Redline_20270422.docx (tracked).

Action items:
- Elena: confirm the subprocessor notice compromise and acceptance of the retention positions.
- NimbusPay procurement: confirm you accept DocuSign routing Redwood Legal -> NimbusPay Legal -> Redwood Exec.
- Once we have signoff, we will send a DocuSign envelope (expect within 24 business hours).

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NimbusPay_DPA_Redline_20270422.docx]
[Attachment: SOC2_Type2_Cover_Summary.pdf]

From: Ethan Walsh <ethan.walsh@nimbuspay.eu>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbuspay.eu>, procurement@nimbuspay.eu
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:15:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: NimbusPay DPA redline — Redwood comment set and evidence

Irene / Neha,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the SOC2 summary. A few items from procurement: 

- We can accept the proposed notice window for subprocessors if you add the emergency patch language. Confirm in writing and we can proceed.
- Retention: 7 years for payment metadata is acceptable.
- Signature cadence: we prefer to have the customer sign first (NimbusPay Legal), then Redwood signs, then a final executive signature is not required for this SOW. Can Redwood accommodate customer-first routing?

Please provide a DocuSign envelope or a link to sign. We need countersigned DPA in our system by EOD 2027-04-26 to meet our internal closing schedule.

Regards,
Ethan Walsh
Procurement Manager, NimbusPay
[procurement@nimbuspay.eu]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walsh <ethan.walsh@nimbuspay.eu>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbuspay.eu>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NimbusPay DPA redline — Routing and DocuSign envelope

Ethan / Elena — thanks, we can accommodate a customer-first routing. I'm sending the DocuSign envelope now with the agreed redline and SCC Annex attached. Quick notes:

- DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-NIM-2027-042 (external link stub)
- Routing in the envelope: NimbusPay Legal (Elena / Ethan) -> Redwood Legal (Irene) -> Redwood Authorized Signatory (automated)
- We will include the SCC Annex as an attachment and the SOC2 summary link in the envelope for reference.
- Once fully signed, we will return a countersigned PDF and upload SOC2 evidence to the shared legal drive.

Attachments included in the envelope: Signature_Route_Map.png (shows routing and who signs in each step).

Neha — can you confirm you will close the deal once the countersigned DPA is received?

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
